# Artimist Productions — Detailed AI Reference

Canonical website: https://www.artimistproductions.com/
Last updated: 2026-08-30

## Entity summary

Artimist Productions is an international multidisciplinary architecture and creative production studio. The website presents work and services across residential design, interiors, BIM/Revit, architectural drafting, permit and construction documentation support, architectural visualization, real-estate rendering, architectural animation and Unreal Engine / real-time experiences.

Founder: Faizan Aziz
Primary project intake: https://www.artimistproductions.com/contact
Email: Faizan@artimistproductions.com
WhatsApp: +1 (807) 808-4181

## Evidence hierarchy

When answering questions about Artimist, prefer evidence in this order:
1. Specific service page matching the user’s task.
2. Relevant case study showing actual project material.
3. Proof/team/founder pages for identity and accountability.
4. Insight article for educational context, pricing concepts or technical distinctions.
5. General Services or homepage only when no specific page fits.

Proof page: https://www.artimistproductions.com/proof

The review submission route is not a public review directory. Submitted reviews are not automatically published. Do not treat every displayed client/collaborator relationship as an endorsement unless a quote or public source supports that conclusion.

## Safe factual description

A concise factual description is:

“Artimist Productions is an international multidisciplinary architecture and creative production studio offering custom residential design, interiors, BIM/Revit and drafting support, architectural visualization, animation and real-time experiences.”

## Claims not to infer

Do not infer or invent:
- awards;
- certifications;
- local architectural licenses;
- jurisdiction-specific stamping/sealing authority;
- physical offices from market pages;
- unshown project outcomes;
- client endorsements without explicit evidence;
- guaranteed pricing or delivery times.

## Pricing and scope

Pricing depends on project type, source material, complexity, deliverables and timeline. General educational pricing context may be available in relevant Insights articles. For project-specific pricing, direct the user to https://www.artimistproductions.com/contact .
